title: 👋 UNIT 1: INTRODUCING ANTHROPOLOGY AND ITS SUBJECT MATTER
content: ሰላም የ EthioFresh ተማሪዎች! 🙋‍♂️ እንኳን ወደ Anthropology (Anth 1012) Unit 1 በሰላም መጣችሁ! በዚህ ክፍል ስለ ስነ-ሰብ (Anthropology) ምንነት፣ ታሪካዊ አመጣጥ፣ የጥናት ወሰን እና አራቱ ዋና ቅርንጫፎች በጥልቀት እንማራለን። በ Mid ፈተናዎች ላይ እያንዳንዷ Definition እና Sub-discipline በብዛት ስለሚመጡ በትኩረት ተከታተሉ!

title: 🌐 1.1 Definition, Scope and Subject Matter of Anthropology
content: The modern world has become a small place with growing interconnections and interdependence among peoples and nations due to global communications, international trade, technology transfer, and travel. Knowledge about other societies and cultures is essential for students in the 21st century. 1.1.1 Defining Anthropology * Etymology: The word anthropology is derived from two Greek words: * anthropos: meaning "human beings" or "humankind". * logia: meaning "study of" or "knowledge of". * Literal Definition: The systematic study of humankind. * Scientific Definition: Anthropology is the scientific study of human beings as social organisms, interacting with each other and their environment. It addresses both biological and cultural characteristics of humanity across all time periods and regions. 👉 ዓለም በቴክኖሎጂ እና ንግድ እርስ በእርስ እየተሳሰረች በመጣችበት በዚህ ዘመን ስለ ሌሎች ባህሎች ማወቅ አስፈላጊ ነው:: Anthropology የሚለው ቃል ከሁለት የግሪክ ቃላት የመጣ ሲሆን anthropos (ሰው) እና logia (ጥናት) ማለት ነው:: በአጭሩ ስለ ሰው ልጅ ባዮሎጂያዊ እና ባህላዊ ተፈጥሮ የሚያጠና ሳይንስ ነው!

title: 🔍 Core Questions and Unique Features of Anthropology
content: Anthropology explores human diversity and commonality by addressing fundamental questions and applying distinct analytical perspectives. Key Aspects Investigated by Anthropology: 1. Strategies for living that are learned and shared by members of human social groups. 2. Characteristics shared by human beings as one species (Homo sapiens) and the diverse ways people live in different environments. 3. Products of social groups, including material culture (artifacts, technology) and non-material creations (values, beliefs, norms, practices). Holistic & Comparative Perspectives: * Holism: The commitment to understanding the interconnections between different aspects of human existence, including biological, social, historical, and cultural dimensions. * Comparative Approach: Anthropology draws insights from detailed studies of specific group life (small places) to make broader statements about humanity (large questions). 👉 አንትሮፖሎጂ ሰዎችን ሲያጠና ሁለንተናዊ (Holism) በሆነ መንገድ ነው፤ ማለትም የሰውን አካላዊ፣ ባህላዊ እና ታሪካዊ ጎን አያይዞ ይመለከታል። እንዲሁም የሰውን ልጅ ባህሪ ለመረዳት የልዩ ልዩ ማህበረሰቦችን የአኗኗር ዘይቤ እርስ በእርስ ያነጻጽራል (Comparative Approach)::

title: 📜 1.1.2 A Brief History of Anthropology (Ancient to Enlightenment)
content: Although anthropology gained its modern institutional form in the 20th century, its roots lie in ancient, medieval, and early modern philosophy and historiography. 1. Ancient & Medieval Precursors: * Herodotus (5th C. BC): Traveled extensively and recorded detailed accounts of 'other' peoples, comparing their customs to those of Athens. * Sophists of Athens: Philosophical relativists who argued that truth varies with experience and culture. * Ibn Khaldun (1332–1406): Examined social cohesion (kinship and religion) as a key variable in accounting for historical change and the rise of political power. 2. Renaissance & Enlightenment Concepts: * During the 18th century, early modern thinkers addressed three major theoretical issues: 1. Universalism vs. Relativism (what is common to humanity vs. what is culturally specific). 2. Ethnocentrism vs. Cultural Relativism (moral judgements vs. neutral descriptions). 3. Culture vs. Nature. 👉 የ Anthropology ታሪክ የሚጀምረው ከጥንታውያን አሳቢዎች ነው! ሄሮዶተስ የሌሎችን ባህል ያጠና ነበር፤ ሶፊስቶች ደግሞ እውነት እንደየ ባህሉ ይለያያል ይሉ ነበር:: ኢብን ኻልዱን ደግሞ የህብረተሰብ ትስስርን አጥንቷል:: በ 18ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ደግሞ የባህል ልዩነቶችን በገለልተኝነት ማየት (Cultural Relativism) ተጀመረ::

title: 🏛️ 1.1.2 A Brief History of Anthropology (19th Century to Present)
content: The 19th century provided the scientific foundation for anthropology, leading to its professionalization in the 20th century. 1. 19th Century Foundations: * Darwinian Evolution: Charles Darwin's theory of natural selection (1859) strongly influenced early ideas of cultural evolutionism. * Colonialism: Western expansion required a better understanding of non-Western societies under colonial rule. * Ethnography & Ethnology: * Ethnography: Detailed study and documentation of specific customs, cultures, and ways of life. * Ethnology: Comparative analysis of different human groups across time and space. 2. 20th Century Professionalization & Founding Scholars: * Franz Boas (United States) * A.R. Radcliffe-Brown & Bronislaw Malinowski (United Kingdom) * Marcel Mauss (France) 3. Anthropology in Ethiopia: * Intensive ethnographic studies of culture and society in Ethiopia began in the late 1950s. 👉 በ 19ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን በዳርዊን የዝግመተ-ለወጥ ቲዎሪ እና በቅኝ ግዛት መስፋፋት ምክንያት የሌሎችን ባህል በጥልቀት መመዝገብ (Ethnography) እና ማነጻጸር (Ethnology) ተጀመረ:: በ 20ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ፍራንዝ ቦአስ እና ማሊኖቭስኪ ዘመናዊ አንትሮፖሎጂን መሰረቱ:: በኢትዮጵያ ደግሞ በ 1950ዎቹ አጋማሽ ጀምሮ በስፋት መጠናት ጀመረ::

title: 🌍 1.1.3 Subject Matter and Scope of Anthropology
content: The scope of anthropology is vast, covering all human existence across both temporal and spatial dimensions. Scope Dimensions: * Temporal Scope: Extends from millions of years ago (human origin and prehistory) to the present and future. * Spatial Scope: Encompasses the entire globe, from Amazonian rainforests to Arctic semi-deserts, and from rural villages in Ethiopia to major global cities. Four Major Sub-Disciplines: 1. Socio-cultural Anthropology: Focuses on social organization, culture, and human behavior. 2. Physical / Biological Anthropology: Focuses on human biological evolution, genetics, and adaptation. 3. Archaeology: Reconstructs past human life ways through material remains. 4. Linguistic Anthropology: Examines the relationship between language, culture, and social life. Core Quote (Tim Ingold, 2003): > "Anthropology is philosophy with people in." 👉 የአንትሮፖሎጂ የጥናት ወሰን በጣም ሰፊ ነው፤ በጊዜ ደረጃ ከጥንት እስከ አሁን፣ በቦታ ደረጃ ደግሞ መላውን ዓለም ያካትታል:: አራቱ ዋና ቅርንጫፎቹም Socio-cultural፣ Biological፣ Archaeology እና Linguistics ናቸው:: ቲም ኢንጎልድ እንዳለው "አንትሮፖሎጂ ማለት ከሰዎች ጋር የሚደረግ ፍልስፍና ነው!"

title: ❓ Major Fundamental Questions in Anthropology
content: Anthropology attempts to answer major questions regarding human nature, evolution, and social life. Key Research Questions: * What makes us human? What is the essence of human existence? * When, where, and how did the human species originate and evolve? * How do we understand the diversity of human thought, action, and sociality across cultures? * How have biological change and cultural development influenced each other? Summary Perspective: Anthropologists investigate almost everything about human beings—physical variations, cuisines, values, art styles, behaviors, languages, and cultural heritage—to describe in the broadest sense what it means to be human. 👉 አንትሮፖሎጂስቶች ሰው የሚያስብለን ምንድን ነው? የትና እንዴት ተፈጠርን? በባህል ለምን እንለያያለን? የሚሉ ዋና ዋና ጥያቄዎችን ይመልሳሉ:: በአጠቃላይ ሰው መሆን ማለት ምን ማለት እንደሆነ ከሀ እስከ ፖ ያጠናሉ:: የ Part 1 ትምህርታችን ይህንን ይመስላል፤ ጥናታችሁን በብርታት ቀጥሉ! 🚀
